objective: Separate benchmark, perception, planning, and execution failures using paired GT oracle interventions.

eligibility_gate.requirement: Audit which GT feature parameters are explicitly constrained by the agent-visible input before assigning perception ownership.
eligibility_gate.failure_effect: Mark Agent-versus-model ownership as confounded by input specification.

conditions.agent_visible_gt: ordered exact feature DAG and parameters

decision_rules.agent_vs_model_ownership: not identified without policy and model controls

limitations: A GT feature program is one valid construction trajectory, not necessarily the unique or shortest trajectory.
A single stochastic run is diagnostic only; causal rate estimates require paired replicates.
A failed plan condition combines model tool use with action translation until an alternate executor policy is tested.
Oracle contrasts localize a failure stage; they do not alone separate Agent scaffolding from base-model capability inside that stage.
An exact-parameter oracle can add information absent from the drawing; its success is not evidence of perception failure until input identifiability passes.
